tool_calls.name:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os, tempfile
p = Path('pipeline/workflow.go')
data = p.read_bytes()
old = b'LoadInput'
new = b'ReadRequest'
if data.count(old) "'!= 2:
    raise SystemExit(f'"'expected 2 occurrences, found {data.count(old)}')
updated = data.replace(old, new)
fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=p.parent, prefix='.workflow.go.')
try:
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(updated)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp, p)
finally:
    if os.path.exists(tmp):
        os.unlink(tmp)
PY
go test ./..."
